blocks.text: Poplar homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Poplar, September 2026. Detached houses: 27 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 30 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 9 sold over 4 months against an average of 26.8 listed, about 11.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 4 sold. Condos and townhomes: 17 sold over 4 months against an average of 23.8 listed, about 5.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold.

faq.a: South Poplar Traditional Elementary at 32746 Huntingdon Road, Jackson Elementary at 33165 King Road and Abbotsford Traditional School at 2272 Windsor Street are physically inside the sub-area; the catchment for a single address must be checked in the SD34 School Locator.

faq.q: Is South Poplar a feeder school for Abbotsford Traditional?
faq.a: Yes — Abbotsford Traditional School states the majority of its Grade 6 students come from its two feeder elementary schools, King and South Poplar, and feeder-school students are automatically registered there for Grades 6–12; the Traditional program is a choice program, so this is a feeder/entry fact, not a catchment assignment.

faq.q: How did Poplar's market do in September 2026?
faq.a: Thinly — detached: 2 solds from 27 listings (7% sales ratio); condos & townhomes: 3 solds from 30 listings (10%). At the Abbotsford community level the detached median sale price was $949,000 and the attached median was $497,500 (small-sample warning on all sub-area figures) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

BC Transit route 3 runs Clearbrook / Huntingdon, route 5 runs Clearbrook / Bourquin via Hospital on Marshall Road at the east edge, route 6 runs the Gladwin corridor and route 12 links UFV and Bourquin Exchange via Jackson Street and McCallum Park and Ride.
